title: Lunenburg RV Park & Campground

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Rarely do you find a campground within a town, especially a UNESCO World Heritage Town! Perched atop Blockhouse Hill, the Lunenburg RV Park & Campground offers an unsurpassed location from which to launch your Lunenburg adventures. With scenic views of both Front and Back harbors, our campground is within easy walking distance of historic downtown Lunenburg and our famous working waterfront. Make Lunenburg your base from which to explore all that our beautiful south shore has to offer. Please Note: Electricity usage is not metered so charges are inclusive where applicable.
